convert_access_control_to_grants: convert an old-style access_control JSON dict to a flat list of grant dicts for a resource
normalize_access_grants: normalize and deduplicate a list of access grant dicts keeping only valid user or group grants
convert_grants_to_access_control: convert a list of access grant objects back to the old-style access_control JSON dict
check_user_has_access: check if a user has read or write permission on a resource using direct grants or group membership
grant_access_to_resource: add a single access grant for a user or group on a resource with idempotent upsert behavior
